title: Image-based lesion-specific immune classification in oligometastatic disease in potentially heterogeneous longitudinal multicenter imaging and irradiation data
summary:
Radiation therapy is an important treatment modality for tumor diseases, not only in early but also in advanced stages. Particularly in cases of low systemic metastatic burden—typically up to five lesions or affected regions, the oligometastatic stage—radiation therapy can be used as a local procedure with high safety and effectiveness. In addition to local control, there is increasing evidence of an immunostimulatory effect of radiation therapy, which also extends beyond the direct radiation field (abscopal effect). However, how individual lesions should be selected and treated is the subject of current research.

Recently, it has been shown that certain molecular characteristics, such as lymphocyte infiltration in the infiltration zone around metastatic lesions, can be estimated using radiomics features or models based on them. These allow for the classification of lesions into hot/cold lesions based on the respective activity of the immune system at that lesion. This, in turn, can be used to irradiate lesions that are poorly accessible to the immune system (cold lesions) with an optimized dose.

This study aims to assemble a retrospective, multi-center cohort of patients with oligometastatic disease. In addition to clinical parameters (especially outcomes), the focus will be on evaluating multi-center radiation and imaging data. The comparability and robustness of image-based analyses and derived parameters, as well as the radiation data, will be specifically addressed. This is essential for performing image-based characterizations of individual lesions (radiomics immune score: hot/cold lesions) with sufficient certainty and for establishing a basis for prospective analyses.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of patients who were treated from 01.01.2010 - 28.02.2023 with radiotherapy and followed up in the oligometastatic stage of the disease.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with extracranial oligometastatic disease (up to 5 lesions or affected (lymph node) regions) who received ablative radiotherapy for the treatment of oligometastases at the respective centers in the period up to 02/2023.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients who did not receive therapy for oligometastatic disease.
